_doc: What the branches merged with menu-layout on 2026-10-08 (mod 3744aa32) changed on purpose, on top of the menu-layout-<variant>.json fixtures (recorded from 6a61dfa8). 511: goneLeaves must be absent, newLeaves must be at exactly that path once. 513: a fixture row listed in tooltips must now show "text" (under "to" when it moved sub-tab) or be gone everywhere ("gone"); an entry that no longer differs from the fixture is stale and fails.

goneLeaves.gui.tab.ArmourDyeTab: inv-batch 701742c2: Armor Recolour became Custom Items (Cosmetics > Custom Items)
goneLeaves.gui.tab.ChatTidyTab: chat-batch a64924b9: merged into Chat Hider
goneLeaves.gui.tab.HideChatMessagesTab: chat-batch a64924b9: merged into Chat Hider
goneLeaves.gui.tab.AbilityTimersTab: gui-hud 805ca633: Ability Timers removed (killer560: "Remove the ability timers setting that is unneeded.")

tooltips.text: With chat open: Shift or Ctrl + Left-Click a message copies the whole message (every wrapped line); Shift or Ctrl + Right-Click copies only the line you clicked. Copied without colour codes. A plain click does what it always did.
tooltips.why: chat-batch a64924b9: Copy Chat takes Shift or Ctrl and copies whole messages

tooltips.text: A private chat with other mod users: /kc <message> sends one line, /chat k makes your typed chat go there.

tooltips.text: Hides Hypixel's combat spam from the chat window: your ability damage lines ('Your Implosion hit 2 enemies for ...') and the hits you take ('A Crypt Wither Skull exploded, hitting you for ...', '... hit you for ...', '... struck you for ...'). Other features still read them, and the log keeps them.
tooltips.why: chat-batch a64924b9: Chat Tidy and Hide Chat Messages became Chat Hider

tooltips.text: A line that repeats one of the last 50 chat messages from the last 60 seconds replaces it: the earlier copy goes, and one line ending in a grey (x2), (x3)... is added at the bottom, even with other messages in between. Blank lines and separators never stack.
tooltips.why: chat-batch a64924b9: Chat Tidy and Hide Chat Messages became Chat Hider
